fields.System.Title: CNT-103 — Schedule counts from a plan
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want count tasks generated automatically each day, so that
counting happens steadily rather than only when someone remembers.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an active plan, then the scheduler generates the day's count tasks.
  • - Given a location with open pick, putaway, or replenishment tasks, then it is skipped
  • and rescheduled rather than counted.
  • - Given a location already having an open count task, then a second is not created.
  • - Given the daily generation, then it respects the plan's volume cap.
  • - Given a skipped location, then the reason is recorded so gaps are explainable.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | counting, inventory |
| Tables | count_plan, count_task |
| Risks | Counting a location with open tasks ([doc 09 §6.5](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); duplicate tasks ([doc 09 §7.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
